history.origins: Italian poker variant (also known as Teresina). The Italian form of five-card stud, played with a stripped deck whose size depends on the number of players.

setup.players:
Minimum Players: 2
Maximum Players: 6
Optimal Players: 4
Partnerships: Optional
setup.deck:
Type: Standard 52-card deck
Number of Decks: 1
Jokers: Not included
setup.dealing: Ante first. Each player receives two cards (one down, one up), dealt clockwise. After first betting round, one face-up card per active player, then betting; repeat until each has four face-up and one face-down (five cards total). Dealing pattern: clockwise.

rules.objective: Win the pot by having the highest hand at showdown.
rules.gameplay: 1. Ante: Each player pays an agreed ante to the pot. 2. Initial deal: Each player receives two cards (one face down, one face up), dealt clockwise. 3. First betting round: Player with highest face-up card starts; ties broken by suit (hearts highest, then diamonds, clubs, spades). 4. Further deal and betting: Another face-up card is dealt to each active player, then a betting round (opener: best pair showing, or highest card, then second card; suits break ties). This repeats until each player has four face-up and one face-down card. 5. Showdown: After the final betting round, active players reveal hands; highest hand wins the pot.
keyRules: Variable stripped deck: lowest rank = 11 minus number of players (e.g. 5 players use 6 to Ace, 36 cards).
Hand ranking: flush ranks above full house (Italian order). Straight flush, four of a kind, flush, full house, straight, three of a kind, two pair, pair, high card.
First bettor each round: best visible hand; ties broken by suit order.

variations.name: Telesina Con Vela
variations.description: One card (la vela) is dealt face down to the table at the start. After the five-card hands and final betting round, la vela is turned face up and there is a final round of betting. In showdown, la vela is a community card; each player makes the best five-card hand from five in hand plus la vela.

variations.name: Telesina with Joker (Con Matte)
variations.description: Dealer selects a rank (e.g. nines) and all cards of that rank are wild. Wild can represent any card; four of a kind plus a wild makes pokerissimo, ranking above straight flush.

variations.name: Telesina con carte coperte
variations.description: All cards dealt face down. After two cards each, each player reveals one card of choice before first betting round; after each subsequent deal, players choose which card to reveal so that each has one face-down and the rest face-up.

variations.name: Telesina con una carta coperta
variations.description: All cards dealt face up except the first and the last. Before the final betting round, each player chooses to show either the first or the last card.
